# Commit numbers before and after the 14 Oct 2026 history rewrite

Claude's name was taken off every commit on main in three repos (bha-engine-dashboard, bha-repair-bridge, bhanetwork-site). The code in every commit is unchanged (each new commit has the identical file tree); only the author line and the Claude co-author lines changed, so every commit has a new number. Old number on the left, new on the right. Look up any old number quoted in a Codex entry, a Slack post or a narration here.
